patch_description:
The current program achieves a combined score of 0.55 with validation accuracy of 0.53 and test accuracy of 0.45. The prior programs showed better performance (0.60 combined score with 0.65 validation accuracy).

Analysis of the current ansatz reveals that while it has good parameter sharing (72 parameters), the hub entanglement layer uses only 2 unique parameters (hub_crx and hub_cry) applied to 4 gates. This creates a bottleneck in expressivity.

The improvement strategy:
1. Increase the expressivity of the hub entanglement by using 4 independent parameters instead of 2 shared ones
2. Add an additional layer of single-qubit RX rotations after the ring entanglement to provide more fine-grained control
3. Maintain the symmetry-inspired structure while allowing more flexibility in the center-to-edge coupling

This approach:
- Increases parameters from 72 to 80 (still reasonable)
- Provides better gradient flow through the hub region
- Allows each edge-to-center connection to learn independently
- Maintains the hierarchical structure that was working well in prior versions
- Balances expressivity with parameter efficiency
